features.label: Translations UI tests

patches.author: Florian Quèze
patches.subject: Re-enable tests disabled on ccov builds that pass there on try.

patches.author: hannajones
patches.subject: Cleanup translations tests that rely on the SRD pref being false

features.summary: These changes make Firefox Translations UI tests more reliable by restoring tests that also pass in coverage builds and cleaning up tests that depended on a particular preference being off. The goal is to catch translation-interface problems consistently without relying on hidden test settings.

features.label: Translations engine & about:translations

patches.author: Mark Banner
patches.subject: Switch from eslint-plugin-import to eslint-plugin-import-x (comment-only changes for ESLint).

features.summary: The translations engine and about:translations page are unchanged for users. The work switches ESLint’s import-checking plugin to a compatible alternative and updates comments, keeping the project’s code-quality checks current.

features.label: Translations UI tests

patches.author: Florian Quèze
patches.subject: Re-enable tests disabled on ccov builds that pass there on try.

patches.author: hannajones
patches.subject: Cleanup translations tests that rely on the SRD pref being false

patches.author: Erik Nordin
patches.subject: Distinguish final paragraph from last-of-type in Translations tests

features.summary: These changes make Firefox Translations UI tests more dependable: tests that pass in coverage builds are re-enabled, and tests are cleaned up so they don’t rely on a preference being off. The tests also more clearly identify the final paragraph, helping ensure they check the intended content rather than whichever paragraph happens to appear last.

features.label: Translations engine tests

patches.author: Florian Quèze
patches.subject: Re-enable tests disabled on Linux that pass there on try.

features.summary: Tests for Firefox’s Translations feature are clearer about what their existing test helpers provide, and checks that pass on Linux have been turned back on there. This helps keep translation behavior covered across platforms and makes the tests easier to understand.

features.label: Translations actors

patches.author: Chris H-C
patches.subject: Test that OHTTP is used for pings that request OHTTP

features.summary: A new test checks that pings asking for OHTTP (Oblivious HTTP, which helps keep a user’s network address private from the service receiving a request) are sent through it. This adds confidence in the privacy handling of these requests; _there’s no visible change for users._

features.label: Translations engine

patches.author: Exploding-Joysticks
patches.subject: Change ConsoleLogLevel and maxLogLevel strings from PascalCase to camelCase

features.summary: The translations engine now uses camelCase rather than PascalCase for its console log-level setting names, making them consistent with the naming style used elsewhere. This is an internal cleanup; it does not change how translations work or appear to users.

features.label: Translations engine & about:translations

patches.author: Mark Banner
patches.subject: Switch from eslint-plugin-import to eslint-plugin-import-x (comment-only changes for ESLint).

features.summary: The translations engine and about:translations page are unchanged for users. The work switches ESLint’s import-checking plugin to a compatible alternative and updates comments, keeping the project’s code-quality checks current.

features.label: Translations engine docs

patches.author: Sylvestre Ledru
patches.subject: no bug - docs: use internal references for in-tree docs instead of firefox-source-docs URLs DONTBUILD

features.summary: In-tree documentation now links to other Firefox source docs using internal references instead of fixed firefox-source-docs URLs. This helps links stay connected to the documentation as it is built and maintained within the source tree; it does not change Firefox behavior.
